dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.description: Interviewers remember answers that are easy to follow and get to the point.

levels.1: Rambling or unclear; the point is hard to find.
levels.5: Direct, well organised and easy to follow throughout.

dimensions.name: Specificity
dimensions.description: Concrete examples make claims believable; generic statements could come from anyone.

levels.3: Some real examples but light on detail.
levels.5: Every claim is backed by a specific example, with details or numbers.

dimensions.name: Motivation and fit
dimensions.description: Recruiters want to see that you know why you want this path and how you fit it.

levels.1: No reason given, or a reason that could apply to any job.
levels.3: A believable reason that is not tied to the role.
levels.5: A clear, personal reason linked to the role and the candidate's own experience.

dimensions.name: Self-awareness
dimensions.description: Honest reflection on strengths and gaps signals you can grow on the job.

levels.5: Honest about strengths and gaps, with evidence of acting on them.
